process_disclosure: Before this file was written, one Bash call ran a no-op `echo placeholder` by mistake. It read no input and changed no state. Everything else before this file used only Read/Grep/Glob.
overall_reason: The update changes three correctness-relevant contracts the old suite encodes: (1) auto-leave of an autoLeave joint config must be un-refusable, must not be duplicated, and must bump pendingConfIndex. Old AutoLeaveAdvance permits a quota drop and requires a duplicate append at every eligible Advance. (2) Leader conf-change admission adds joint-state refusals, and zero-payload proposals are no longer quota-refused; ProposalContract/ExpectedDecision encode the old rules. (3) A transfer whose target is demoted to learner is aborted, and no old property states this. Other changes are representational (sorted campaign order, maybeTerm/IsEmptyHardState refactors, value receivers, Describe* formatting, test harness) or model-only (Next=lastIndex for new progress, probe-on-config-switch, nil-Data payload size). Standard safety properties are kept as controls.

entries.name: AutoLeaveAdvance (UpdateAutoLeaveAdvance alias)
entries.change_kind: semantic (relaxes the old must-append when a leave is already pending; strengthens by removing the quota-drop escape and requiring the pendingConf bump) + observer migration
evidence: raft.go advance (new): `oldApplied < r.pendingConfIndex && newApplied >= r.pendingConfIndex`; Data nil; `panic("refused un-refusable auto-leaving ConfChangeV2")`; `r.pendingConfIndex = r.raftLog.lastIndex()` after append
raft.go increaseUncommittedSize: `s > 0` requirement; comment: appending single empty entries always succeeds, 'used ... for auto-leaving joint configurations'
raft_test.go TestUncommittedEntryLimit (new): 'we can always append an entry with no Data ... auto-transitioning out of joint config states'

testdata/confchange_v2_add_double_auto.txt: 'There used to be a bug in which these proposals would prompt the leader to transition out of the same joint state multiple times, which would cause a panic.'
rawnode_test.go (new): pendingConfIndex expected = lastIndex+1 for auto-leaving changes (bump to the auto-leave entry index)
raft.proto ConfState.auto_leave: 'Raft will automatically transition into the final config ... when this is safe'; ConfChangeV2: leaving = ConfChangeV2 with only (optionally) Context
entries.old_expression: \A a\in history.autoLeaveChecks: a.eligible => (append one V2 changes=<<>> entry) \/ (a.decision="DropQuota" /\ a.pending=Len(a.afterHist))
entries.proposed_expression: AutoLeaveDue(a) == a.eligible /\ a.cursor>0 /\ a.appliedOK ; LeavePending(a) == \E k\in (a.cfgLen+1)..a.beforeLast: IsLeave(a.afterHist[k]) ; AutoLeaveAdvance == \A a\in history.autoLeaveChecks: AutoLeaveDue(a) => IF LeavePending(a) THEN Len(a.afterHist)=a.beforeLast ELSE /\ Len(a.afterHist)=a.beforeLast+1 /\ IsLeave(a.afterHist[Len(a.afterHist)]) /\ a.afterHist[Len(a.afterHist)].id=0 /\ a.pending=Len(a.afterHist)
disagreement_states: D1 duplicate append: leader, config joint+autoLeave, cfgHist ends at joint entry J, log already holds an auto-leave entry L>cursor, Advance with cursor>=pendingConf (old code: pendingConf not bumped; or EarlyAdvance with L in batch). Old code appends a second leave. Old property: TRUE (requires it). Proposed: FALSE.
D2 quota-refused auto-leave (old code): quota>0 and quota+2>MaxUncommitted, so the leave is dropped and pendingConf=lastIndex. Old property: TRUE via the DropQuota disjunct. Proposed: FALSE.

D3 control, edge-trigger miss (new code): leader elected with applied==pendingConf==lastIndex in an autoLeave joint config; the next Advance (cursor=lastIndex+1) appends nothing. Old: FALSE. Proposed: FALSE. Both keep rejecting it.

entries.name: history.autoLeaveChecks observer (ProtocolAdvance)
evidence: The proposed AutoLeaveAdvance needs to know whether a leave is already pending after the last applied conf entry. It also needs the Advance cursor, not the stale `decision` field. `decision` is sticky across steps, so an older DropQuota proposal can falsely satisfy the old disjunct.
entries.proposed_expression: Add fields cursor |-> b.cursor, cfgLen |-> Len(r.cfgHist), appliedOK |-> AppliedTo(r,b.cursor).fatal="", oldPending |-> r.pendingConf. Keep the old fields unchanged so the old property keeps its old meaning on new records.
disagreement_states: Same as AutoLeaveAdvance D1/D2. The old record cannot tell D1 (pending leave) from the legitimate first auto-leave.

entries.name: ProposalConfigurationDecisions / ProposalContract
entries.change_kind: semantic (new joint-state admission rules; quota relaxation for zero-weight batches) + observer migration (add joint)
evidence: raft.go stepLeader (new): refused if alreadyPending; else if alreadyJoint && !wantsLeaveJoint 'must transition out of joint config first'; else if !alreadyJoint && wantsLeaveJoint 'not in joint state; refusing empty conf change'. A refused entry becomes EntryNormal. pendingConfIndex is bumped only for admitted entries.
raft.proto ConfChangeV2: leave = ConfChangeV2 with only the Context field set (zero Transition, no Changes)
increaseUncommittedSize: `s > 0` requirement
entries.old_expression: rewritten == {k: conf(k) /\ (pending>applied \/ some earlier conf entry in batch)}; DropQuota iff quota>0 /\ quota+weight>MaxUncommitted
entries.proposed_expression: RefusedConf(es,k,pend,joint) sequential: a conf entry is refused iff pend \/ (joint /\ ~IsLeave(e)) \/ (~joint /\ e.kind="V2" /\ e.changes=<<>>). An admitted conf entry sets pend. DropQuota iff quota>0 /\ weight>0 /\ quota+weight>MaxUncommitted. The observer adds joint |-> r.config.outgoing#{}.
disagreement_states: P1 leader in joint config, nothing pending, proposes V2 Auto <<AddVoter s3>>. New code rewrites it to a Normal no-op. Old contract FALSE on new behavior and TRUE on old; proposed contract the reverse.
P2 leader in non-joint config proposes V2 Auto <<>> (leave). New code refuses it. Old contract demands admission.
P4 quota relaxation: quota=3>MaxUncommitted=2, Normal weight 0. New code accepts. Old contract expects DropQuota.
P5 joint config + V2 JointExplicit <<>>. New code admits it (len(Changes)==0), but it is not a leave per raft.proto and panics at apply. Proposed contract: refuse, so the code is flagged.

disagreement_states: outcome record: leader, member, transfer=0, quota=3, weight=0, decision=Accepted. Old FALSE, proposed TRUE. Control: weight=1, decision=Accepted. Both FALSE.

suspected_defects: NEW CODE edge-trigger miss: `oldApplied < pendingConfIndex` never fires for a leader elected with applied == pendingConfIndex (== lastIndex) in an autoLeave joint config. The joint config is never auto-left, against raft.proto auto_leave. The old code (>=) fired here.

NEW CODE with early Advance (README/node.go allow Advance before applying): if Advance runs before ApplyConfChange of the auto-leave entry L, `oldApplied < L <= newApplied` with config still autoLeave appends a second leave, and applying it panics. Likewise, if the joint entry is applied after its Advance, the edge has passed and no leave is ever appended.

NEW CODE admission: wantsLeaveJoint := len(Changes)==0 admits V2{Transition: JointExplicit/Implicit, Changes: nil} in a joint config. Apply then routes to EnterJoint, which fails with 'config is already joint' and panics.
OLD CODE (fixed by the update): duplicate auto-leave, a quota-refusable auto-leave, admission of non-leave conf changes in joint configs, and a demoted transferee not aborted.

MODEL: AdvanceCore, AppendQuotaExceeded, RewriteConf, ChangeProgress (Next=last+1) and ApplyConfCore (transfer abort on members) encode old behavior and need migration. AutoLeaveWeight/Encoded should become 0/6.
unresolved_obligations: Prompt probing of newly added replicas (switchToConfig else-branch plus Next=lastIndex) is a latency/liveness behavior. No safety property is proposed; CatchupProgress is not model-checked.
ConfigurationTransitionSafety exempts every id=0 entry, including auto-leave entries. Repairing it to exempt only bootstrap AddVoter entries is deferred.
Admitted conf changes must be valid at apply (no panic). This is only partly captured by the joint rule in ProposalContract; removing the last voter, for example, is still admitted.
CampaignContract counts V2 entries as pending conf while numOfPendingConf counts only EntryConfChange. This is a pre-existing mismatch outside the update.
